1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __in a molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200 to 900__ nm in diameter.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __1500__ Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __in a molar ratio of PVS to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1__.

13) (Original) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 __wherein the polyalkylenimine is less than 1500 Da__; b) a polymer __with anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate.

26) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
